source_sections: regimes from section 4, overlays from section 3
registration_note: REGISTERED 2026-10-16 - display only. The 10 regimes and 7 overlays are registered as written. Registration makes the labels rules; it does NOT make the card a gate. Nothing in the hub reads this label to change caps, gates, the kill-switch or the journal (convention 42, section 1).
not_a_signal: Section 1: this is context and a risk governor, not a signal. It never says buy X or short Y, never ranks tickers, and nothing in the hub uses its label to change caps, gates, the kill-switch or the journal (convention 42).
held_policy: No text is held in v2. The policy stands for any future text: a line whose wording reads as an instruction is NOT reworded by BUILD and NOT shipped - it is withheld, counted, and reported for the ruled rewording. v1 held three such sentences and R-IV.1189 supplied their pricing-fact form.

crash_liquidation.label: Crash / Liquidation
matters_now: credit spreads and the funding/carry crosses
liquidity: bid-ask spreads widen, stops gap
crash_liquidation.tape: Everything correlated falls; cash, short-dated Treasuries and the dollar/yen hold; quality defensives fall less [MKT]. Counterexample: snap-back days of +3-5% inside crashes.
crash_liquidation.premium: EXPENSIVE. Premium is at its most expensive here: options bought in a spike are priced for the move that already happened. This is the regime where tails bought earlier are worth the most. Existing rules that apply: the two-contract rule, and X3 (60–70% of max value under 21 DTE).
crash_liquidation.ending_signs: Backwardation resolving to contango; VIX lower highs on new index lows; credit stops widening; a breadth thrust.
crash_liquidation.proves_wrong: Contango back on 2 closes with credit stable, and the label exits.

bear_market.label: Bear Market
bear_market.tape: Defensives (staples, health care, utilities) lead on a relative basis; cyclicals and high beta lag. Counterexample: 2022 energy led.
bear_market.premium: Fair-to-expensive. Defined-risk structures. The C5/Z2 gates allow B1/B2 shorts only after a confirmed downtrend.
bear_market.ending_signs: A breadth thrust; credit healing; 2 closes above the 50dma with the 20 > 50 cross.
bear_market.proves_wrong: SPY back above a flattening 200dma for 5 closes.

bear_market_rally.label: Bear-Market Rally
matters_now: where the rally stalls versus the falling 200dma and the prior breakdown zone (PYTHIA's acceptance test)
bear_market_rally.tape: short squeezes, with the most-beaten-down names ripping hardest. Counterexample: some rallies become the real bottom (Recovery).
bear_market_rally.premium: puts lose twice, on direction and on falling vol. A -3x inverse ETF loses about 9% on a +3% index day [MKT]. The bounce is the trap for both sides.
bear_market_rally.ending_signs: Rejection at the falling 200dma (bear resumes), or acceptance above it with credit healing (Recovery).

breakdown.label: Breakdown
matters_now: the 50dma break was confirmed; does it follow through to the 200dma?
breakdown.tape: Leadership narrows further; small caps and high beta lag.
breakdown.premium: Fair to expensive. Debit spreads over outright puts. This is the first regime where a market-level short stops being before-the-turn under C5 (it is shown as a meter).
breakdown.ending_signs: A failed breakdown: 2 closes back above the 50dma with volume.
breakdown.proves_wrong: The reclaim, which moves the label to Correction or Recovery.

recovery.label: Recovery
recovery.tape: Early cyclicals and small caps often lead off a bottom [MKT]. Counterexample: rallies that fail become a Bear-Market Rally.
recovery.premium: CRUSHING. Long premium loses value fastest as volatility deflates. Tails have historically been cheapest again once VIX is back in its low band with normal contango.
recovery.ending_signs: To Uptrend after 5 closes above the 200dma; back to Bear on rejection.

correction.label: Correction
matters_now: the SPY 50dma flip line: a confirmed break means Breakdown
VIX term structure: backwardation unlocks the crash check
correction.tape: Defensives and energy relatively stronger, high beta weaker. Counterexample: most corrections without a credit or recession confirmation have not become bear markets [MKT].
correction.premium: Fair to expensive. Debit spreads beat outright puts. Short dated puts cost the most.
correction.ending_signs: QQQ and IWM back above their 50dma (back to Uptrend), or a confirmed SPY 50dma break (Breakdown).
correction.proves_wrong: QQQ and IWM both reclaim their 50dma on 2 closes.

range_chop.label: Range / Chop
range_chop.premium: sellers' market. The worst regime for leveraged ETFs, because daily-reset decay is highest when the index chops flat. A -3x fund loses roughly 6 x variance, about 0.15% a day at 25% vol [MKT]. Long options decay without paying.
range_chop.ending_signs: ADX above 25, with a confirmed break either side.

melt_up.label: Melt-Up
matters_now: spot-up/vol-up: VIX rising while SPY rises = fragility
melt_up.tape: Momentum and the most-loved themes lead. Counterexample: melt-ups end abruptly, usually after a breadth divergence.
melt_up.premium: calls get expensive; puts are cheap. Tails are cheapest here, but a before-the-turn short is still capped at B3/TAIL (C5), with the entering-parabolic-shorts-too-early flag on its face.
melt_up.ending_signs: Breadth divergence (index up, % above 50dma down); failed breakout; credit widening.
melt_up.proves_wrong: Nothing; it is a state. The exit is to Uptrend or Narrow Uptrend.

uptrend.label: Uptrend
uptrend.premium: CHEAP. Tails are cheapest here: longer-dated far-OTM tickets cost the least decay per day. A bearish view in this regime is early, not wrong-by-price; C5 applies.
uptrend.ending_signs: Sector count falls below 5 of 11; IWM loses its 50dma; new lows outnumber new highs.

narrow_uptrend.label: Narrow Uptrend
matters_now: the index is held up by a few leaders while participation shrinks
narrow_uptrend.tape: A handful of mega-caps; everything else lags. Counterexample: narrow markets can run for months.
narrow_uptrend.ending_signs: A leader breaks its 50dma; IWM downtrend deepens; credit widens.
narrow_uptrend.proves_wrong: Broadening, with 5 or more sectors above their 50dma and IWM reclaiming.

war_middle_east.label: War - Middle East
war_middle_east.watch_when: 2 whitelisted, dated sources within 12h report a kinetic event, strait incident or hit on oil infrastructure.
war_middle_east.active_needs: Measured confirmation from 2 or more different families: Brent +5% on the session; VIX-spike breaker; USDJPY -1% with gold up; SPY gap of -1% or worse.
war_middle_east.clears_when: Brent gives back half its spike, VIX back in contango, and PYTHIA's gap test fails (price back inside prior value).

taiwan_strait.label: Taiwan Strait
taiwan_strait.watch_when: Formal quarantine, blockade or inspection announcement, or a shipping advisory. Drills alone are logged only.
taiwan_strait.active_needs: SMH -4% with TSM lagging; USDJPY -1%; VIX breaker - plus Nick's acknowledgement. This overlay is the one exception that also needs his acknowledgement to go ACTIVE.
taiwan_strait.clears_when: Stand-down announced and SMH recovers half its drop.

oil_shock.label: Oil shock
oil_shock.active_needs: Brent +25% over 20 sessions with crack spread widening, plus one non-oil family.
oil_shock.clears_when: Brent back under +10% versus 20 sessions earlier.

credit_stress.label: Credit stress
credit_stress.watch_when: Credit factor at -1.0 for 3 settled sessions, or HY spread +50bp in a month.
credit_stress.active_needs: HY spread +100bp in a month (or +25bp in a week), plus XLF/KRE new 20-day lows.
credit_stress.clears_when: Spread narrows for 2 weeks, or a backstop is announced.

carry_unwind.label: Carry unwind
carry_unwind.watch_when: AUDJPY and MXNJPY each -1.5% in a session.
carry_unwind.active_needs: Plus USDJPY -1.5%, VIX in backwardation on a close.
carry_unwind.clears_when: Crosses steady for 3 sessions and VIX back in contango.

ai_capex_unwind.label: AI-capex unwind
ai_capex_unwind.watch_when: A hyperscaler capex-guidance cut (primary filing or call), or SMH below its 50dma with 3 or more AI themes fading.
ai_capex_unwind.active_needs: SMH confirmed C5 break, plus a credit family.
ai_capex_unwind.clears_when: Guidance restored, or SMH back above its 50dma. Carries a permanent bias flag: it is Nick's thesis.

macro_slowdown.label: Macro slowdown (recession / stagflation flavour)
macro_slowdown.watch_when: Sahm 0.4 or more, or 4-week claims +15% off their low, or ISM below 48.
macro_slowdown.active_needs: Sahm 0.5 or more and claims +20%. Flavour is stagflation if breakevens are rising.

overlay_state_machine.states: CLEAR -> WATCH -> ACTIVE -> FADING -> CLEAR, plus a grey STALE state if the watcher misses a check-in. A STALE chip can never read CLEAR.
overlay_state_machine.news_cannot_activate: News can only raise WATCH. ACTIVE fires automatically when the market confirms. No person can force it.
overlay_state_machine.timers: WATCH with no market confirmation expires after 72h, logged as expired-unconfirmed. ACTIVE fades after 5 trading sessions unless both keys fire again.
overlay_state_machine.buttons: Acknowledge silences repeat pushes. Dismiss (with a logged reason) clears it. There is no Upgrade and no Extend - the person who forecast the event should not be the one who activates it.

costs_on_the_card.hysteresis: Entering a regime takes 2 settled closes, and a regime lasts 5 sessions before it can change again - except a move toward more risk, which can happen any time but still needs 2 closes. Range needs 10 sessions.
costs_on_the_card.stated_cost: This makes the module late at V-shaped bottoms, and fast-toward-risk flatters a bearish lean.
costs_on_the_card.excluded_inputs: market_breadth (RSP-SPY, sign-unaware per TA-193) and the Robotics theme score (corrupted) are excluded, and the card says so.
